title: Module adjunction retaining its underlying topos transpose
statement: For essentially small sites J and K in a common coefficient universe, a finite-limit-preserving set-sheaf functor L with right adjoint V, and a specified algebraic inverse image I from a commutative ring sheaf R to its inverse-image ring RI [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], there exist a module right-adjoint functor P, an underlying-sheaf isomorphism eP from P to V, and an adjunction I.modules ⊣ P. For every linear f:I(M)→H, forgetting its module adjunct and composing with eP is exactly the set-sheaf adjunct of I.moduleUnderlying.inv followed by the underlying f. Thus the adjunction is normalized by the given topos transpose, rather than only specified up to an arbitrary automorphism.

proof.text: Use the product-preserving right-module construction and its operation equations. The addition and scalar binary-mate equations characterize precisely which set-sheaf adjuncts are linear. Restrict the set Hom equivalence to those maps; faithfulness proves its inverse laws. Naturality of the underlying comparisons and the set adjunction proves left and right naturality. Construct the adjunction from that natural equivalence, retaining the already proved underlying-transpose equation.

theorem normalizedModuleAdjunction_exists
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (RI : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
    (F : Sheaf J (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type u))
    (V : Sheaf K (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u))
    (adj : F ⊣ V) [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage F R RI) :
    ∃ P : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RI) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R),
      ∃ (eP : P ⋙ toSheaf _ ⋙ sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≅
          (toSheaf _ ⋙ sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})) ⋙ V)
        (a : I.modules ⊣ P),
        ∀ M H (f : I.modules.obj M ⟶ H),
          (toSheaf _ ⋙ sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).map
              (a.homEquiv M H f) ≫ eP.hom.app H =
            adj.homEquiv _ _ (I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app M ≫
              (toSheaf _ ⋙ sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).map f)
